question: Which of the following novels is written by RK Narayan and also adapted into a Hindi film by the same name?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Guide**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The novel "The Guide" was written by RK Narayan, one of the most celebrated Indian authors known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.
 
• "The Guide" was adapted into a Hindi film of the same name, directed by Vijay Anand and starring Dev Anand and Waheeda Rehman.
 
• The story revolves around a tour guide, Raju, who transforms into a spiritual guide and then into one of the greatest holy men of India.
 
• The film and the book, although sharing the same basic plot, differ in their treatment and character development, reflecting the director's vision and the medium's requirements.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 Option 3: Devdas
 A novel by Sarat Chandra Chattopadhyay, not by RK Narayan. It has been adapted into multiple films in various languages.
 
 

 Option 4: 3 Idiots
 A Bollywood film inspired by the novel "Five Point Someone" by Chetan Bhagat, not related to RK Narayan's works.
